inputs.description: Release version, PEP 440 without a leading v (e.g. 0.6.1 or 0.6.1rc3)

tasks.label: Setup: uv sync (dev)
tasks.detail: Create or update .venv from uv.lock with the dev tools.

tasks.label: Test: tests
tasks.detail: Synthetic test suite (the same tests CI runs).

tasks.label: Validate: real data (manual)
tasks.detail: Checks on approved real zips; run by hand before every rc and release. Not run by CI.

tasks.label: Release: prep (local, no network)
tasks.detail: Bump the version files and rename the Unreleased section; keeps the hand-written release notes. No Git, no network.

tasks.label: Release: open upstream PR (dry run)
tasks.command: uv run --locked --extra dev python scripts/release_pr.py --dry-run --repo BrkRaw/brkraw --version ${input:releaseVersion}
tasks.detail: Print every step without writing files, running Git commands that change anything, or using the network.

tasks.label: Release: open upstream PR (--repo BrkRaw/brkraw)
tasks.command: uv run --locked --extra dev python scripts/release_pr.py --repo BrkRaw/brkraw --version ${input:releaseVersion}
tasks.detail: Run on release/<version>: prep, tests, commit, push the branch to origin (no tags), open the PR on BrkRaw/brkraw with the release label.
